question.text: An Informant who files a Voluntary Information Disclosure Form under SEBI (PIT) Regulations is protected against retaliation. Which professional category is excluded from the definition of 'employee' for this protection?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Regulation 7I, 'employee' includes a director, partner, regular employee, or contractual employee, but does not include an advocate. The Trap: Advocates may possess inside information through their clients but are still excluded from the employee definition for the purpose of this chapter; the workbook does not give a stated reason. Note: Per NISM-III-C (Securities Intermediaries Compliance - Fund) workbook (p.122).
